title: STING-HLA-E innate activation border
notes: A tissue margin where dense HLA-E signal (blue) concentrates at the leading edge alongside diffuse STING expression (green), with TP53-positive nuclei (red) throughout the cellular mass. Measured HLA-E and STING co-localization (IoU 0.49) and strong HLA-E to HLA A overlap in this region indicate coordinated MHC-I and innate sensing pathway engagement, consistent with an interferon-driven innate immune activation zone at the tumor periphery. Background IRF3-NFkB co-expression further supports active cGAS-STING-TBK1 signaling in this compartment.
